description_en: Invoke the DeleteGroupIpMappingRule API to delete the IP redirection information of an instance group authorization rule.
description_zh: 调用DeleteGroupIpMappingRule接口删除实例组授权规则IP重定向信息
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc delete-group-ip-mapping-rule --iot-cloud-connector-group-id iotccg-g00epppbi9di9y0000 --group-ip-mapping-rule-id im-irrp3bzuu5nrbx0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteGroupIpMappingRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud connector instance group.
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance group IP redirection authorization rule to be deleted.
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的实例组IP重定向的授权规则的ID
parameters.name: group_ip_mapping_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request.  

Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client to guarantee uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.  

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request.
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run of the request. Valid values:  
true: Sends a dry run request without deleting the IP redirection information of the instance group authorization rule. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether the request complies with business limits. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.  
false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed.
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会删除实例组授权规则IP重定向信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the instance group.  

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html API to obtain the region ID.
parameters.help_zh:
实例组所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
